It does not self-heal: the stale entry carries pid_source 'self', and pid-liveness is trusted only for 'explicit' entries, so although pid 36602 is measurably dead the entry would have held its slot for the rest of the 90-minute TTL — under-reporting fleet capacity by 25% on the mechanism whose whole job is reporting capacity.

A fresh-scratch-dir probe cannot reach this: the bug exists only on migration, from a pool that already holds a pid-keyed entry. Every currently-running lane hits it exactly once as it adopts the fix. Workaround applied here: delete your own leaked pid-keyed file after the first --agent register. Suggest folding this into base-template-18's carryover rather than three lanes rediscovering it.
